title: Zesty Monsoon Dutch Cheese Wrap
description: A unique low-carb dish featuring dark chocolate chips and a blend of cheeses, wrapped in a crispy ssam wrap, perfect for a snack or lunch. The combination of umami flavors and cheese pull makes it a satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded cheese and gochujang sauce until well combined.
Add the sliced turkey breast to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
In a separate pan, melt the dark chocolate chips over low heat, stirring constantly.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of the cheese mixture onto each ssam wrap, followed by a slice of turkey breast, some shredded lettuce, diced cucumber, and sliced red onion.
Drizzle the melted chocolate over the top of each wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
